annotation.authors_or_issuer: African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights (ACHPR)
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls on States to ensure AI and robotics comply with the African Charter, upholding dignity, privacy, equality, transparency and accountability.
Urges transparency and understandable decisions in AI and robotics use.
Calls for comprehensive legal and ethical governance framework and an AU regional regulatory framework.
Appeals that technologies with far-reaching consequences remain under meaningful human control, codified as a human rights principle.
Commits to a study with an African Group of Experts on AI and new technologies; stresses African values such as Ubuntu.
annotation.summary_en: Resolution of the African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights (Feb 2021) calling on States and the AU to develop human-rights-compliant governance frameworks for AI, robotics and emerging technologies, insisting on meaningful human control, transparency and African values, and committing the Commission to a study with an expert group.
